I · The upper city

The business model

Every successful criminal enterprise requires capital. Ours just happens to come in the form of mana rocks. While the table assembles its engines, we build the infrastructure necessary to operate theirs.

Xanathar is not a conventional control commander: he converts spare mana into access to an opponent's library. Protect the investment, choose the right opponent, and keep enough capital available to exploit the opportunity.

The treasury

Capital before conquest

Prioritize early colored mana and affordable rocks. Large investments such as Thran Dynamo and Gilded Lotus are most useful when they leave mana available after deploying an engine. Nyx Lotus depends on devotion; Sol Talisman requires patience.

II · Behind closed doors

The procurement office

Choose a tutor to inspect its artifact targets. Search restrictions use mana value, not the amount paid.

III · The undercity

The syndicate

Browse the nonland assets by department, ordered by mana value within each group. The land inventory is filed separately in the Ledger.

Classified operations

The heist

Insider trading

Xanathar + Bilbo + Codex Shredder: reduce generic costs and clear an unwanted top card. Shredder taps to mill only one card.

Black market inventory

Ruin Crab + Dauthi Voidwalker + Polluted Delta: up to 18 void-counter cards across three opponents. Voidwalker grants access to just one per activation.

Cooking the books

Brainstorm followed by a tutor or fetchland shuffle clears unwanted cards from your own library.

Executive protection

Attach Kaya's Ghostform before Lightning Greaves. Shroud prevents your own targeting too.

Debt collection

Brainstealer Dragon rewards opposing-owned nonland permanents entering under your control, not merely changing control.

Risk management

Artifact wipes and repeated commander removal are serious threats. Avoid deploying all your capital into a known wipe.

Playing the odds

Keep hands with lands, deployable acceleration and a route to an engine. A rock-heavy hand without enough lands can be deceptive.

Seven-card hand, 99-card library, no mulligans. Does not model mana colors or timing.

The fine print

Play includes lands; cast does not. Normal timing and land limits apply unless an effect explicitly changes them. Xanathar's resolved upkeep effect lasts through the turn even if he leaves. Nightveil Specter and Thada Adel do not provide alternate mana spending permission. Tasha casts from exile with page counters, not directly from graveyards. Xanathar stops only the chosen opponent from casting spells; other opponents can still respond. Free casting does not waive mandatory additional costs. Dauthi Voidwalker requires an untapped creature without summoning sickness (or with haste).
